title: SQP-Type Methods for Quaternion Negative Semidefinite Matrix Cone Constrained Optimization Problems
content: This paper studies the nonlinear programming problem with quaternion self-conjugate negative semidefinite matrix constraints(QNSDP). A theoretical framework for QNSDP is constructed, and an efficient numerical algorithm is designed. First, a projection operator on the space of quaternion self-conjugate matrices is defined, and constraint qualifications such as the Robinson constraint qualification, the constraint nondegeneracy condition, and the strict complementarity condition are provided. It is proved that the Lagrange multiplier set is nonempty and bounded if and only if the Robinson constraint qualification holds, among other results. Second, the KKT conditions and second-order optimality conditions are established, and an explicit expression for the critical cone is given, then SQP-type methods for solving QNSDP is proposed. Under the different assumptions, the convergence of the algorithm is proved. Finally, numerical experiments verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.
